- **B:** Each of the two black triangles is half of a quadrant:
  \[
  A_B=2\left(\frac12\cdot\frac14\right)=\frac14.
  \]

- **C:** Each black diamond has diagonals of length \(\frac12\). Its area is
  \[
  \frac12\left(\frac12\right)\left(\frac12\right)=\frac18.
  \]
  Thus,
  \[
  A_C=2\cdot\frac18=\frac14.
  \]

- **D:** Each of the four black triangles has base \(\frac12\) and height \(\frac14\), so each has area
  \[
  \frac12\left(\frac12\right)\left(\frac14\right)=\frac1{16}.
  \]
  Hence,
  \[
  A_D=4\cdot\frac1{16}=\frac14.
  \]

All four squares therefore contain the same total black area.

\[
